snippet.title: Buckvale trailer: a cozy farming game you play free in your browser
snippet.description:
Buckvale is the cozy farming game I'm making on my own in Latvia. Grow crops that never wilt, meet the neighbours, adopt a dog or a cat, look after the cows, go fishing, plant an orchard and furnish your home. Winter Lights is on until 6 January.

Play free in your browser on phone or PC, no download: https://buckvale.com/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=video&utm_campaign=trailer

Everything is recorded in the real game, with Buckvale's own music.

#cozygames #indiegame #farminggame
